top_story.title: Dow Falls 200 Points. Nasdaq Down 1.4%.
top_story.summary: The Dow is down 200 points, or 0.4%, following the Nasdaq and S&P 500 deeper into the red.  Caterpillar stock was the worst-performing Dow component, down 5.6%.  The construction equipment company, which has become an AI infrastructure play, dropped after announcing its acquisition of mining solutions company, Skycatch.
